title: Dynamic noise-fence probe and graceful reserve scaler
creator: Aisha Patel
description: After the 2026-02-28 dedicated-cluster capacity incident we observed a multi-tenant eviction cascade driven by a single noisy workload pattern: a short-lived model variant that aggressively grew KV cache and consumed burst credits faster than its reservation predicted. This ticket defines a detection probe (dynamic noise-fence) and a graceful reserve scaler that together aim to: 1) identify stealth noisy tenants within 10 minutes of anomaly onset; 2) apply soft isolation to prevent eviction storms; 3) adjust reservation sizing automatically based on recent p95 token and cache usage; and 4) provide operator-visible rollback and audit trails. Scope: dedicated GPU pools only (no hosted API changes). Excludes long-term billing/chargeback work which will be tracked separately.
acceptance_criteria: Noise-fence probe reliably flags noisy tenant fingerprints in staging within 5-10 minutes with <5% false positive rate (measured by synthetic runs)

Graceful reserve scaler can increase/decrease reservation by up to 2x (up or down) based on 30m moving window signals and completes changes without triggering eviction events in 95% of synthetic tests
Soft isolation (token-bucket gating) throttles noisy tenants before eviction threshold and degrades them to cached-prefetch policy without impacting unaffected tenants
Playbook and dashboard entries created; oncall can trigger manual isolate/unisolate and view last 90d telemetry per tenant
Automated canary run in dedicated-staging passes with no SLO regressions for 48h
tasks: Design probe metrics: burst_credit_rate, kv_cache_growth_slope, seq_length_outliers, qps_spike_ratio
Implement probe service that emits tenant_fingerprint events to telemetry pipeline
Build graceful_reserve_scaler service with safety checks and operator approvals for >1.5x ramp
Add soft-isolation token-bucket gate and compatible fallback policy that swaps heavy KV cache models to reduced-cache runtime
Create synthetic tenant harness (k-synthetic) to exercise edge cases: cache-leak, burst-surge, combined-sequence-padding
Dashboard: per-tenant reservation utilization, recent isolations, pending reserve changes, and estimated cost delta
Run 3 release-day drills and document rollback/fast-unisolate procedure
Write e2e tests for isolation + autoscaler interactions and include in CI gating

2026-03-08 - Elena García (SRE): Telemetry schema PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/482 - emits tenant_fingerprint.{burst_ratio,kv_growth,seq_outliers}. Reviewed — small naming nit fixed.

2026-03-09 - Marcus Li: Prototype of probe emits events to ops stream. Running in dedicated-staging against synthetic workload. Initial detection time ~12m; tuning threshold lowered to hit target ~8m detection.

2026-03-10 - Design review notes: prefer soft isolation over hard eviction to preserve customer UX. Agree to limit autoscaler to max 2x delta without operator review. Added requirement for audit-log entries for any automated changes.

2026-03-11 - Marcus Li: Implemented token-bucket gate in runtime-path and added fallback policy that reduces per-request KV window and enables recompute strategy. Benchmarks: tail latency for co-tenants improved by 22% in staged synthetic run.
